status: Hypothetical account economics and incremental paid-tier buyer case; not Ramp financial estimates
boundary: Platform proceeds rate is hypothetical cash credited after partner/network sharing but before customer rewards and risk/funding costs; it is not an interchange schedule, merchant processing fee, audited gross revenue or GAAP margin. Annual contributions omit acquisition, corporate overhead, taxes and capital. Buyer seat price is the October13 monthly-list analogue; platform fee and all savings are assumed, with no annual discount or payment-method fees. Buyer incremental benefits compare paid workflow to the previous/free workflow; unchanged card rewards are excluded.
